questions.explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。医生朋友得知作者一直胃痛，所以在漫长的工作后顺道来“查看/探望”作者。check up on 意为“核对，检查，探望（某人是否安好）”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(checked up on)：语境句：My parents always check up on me to make sure I'm studying. 固定搭配：check up on sb/sth, a routine check-up
B(worked in with)：语境句：Your ideas work in well with our overall plan. 固定搭配：work in with, work in harmony
C(closed in on)：语境句：The police were closing in on the suspect's hiding place. 固定搭配：close in on sb, winter is closing in
D(looked up to)：语境句：He has always looked up to his elder brother as a role model. 固定搭配：look up to sb, look down upon sb

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。上文提到作者有持续的胃痛，且来看望作者的是一位“医生朋友(doctor friend)”。朋友得知作者没有去看“医生(doctor)”就自行服用止痛药，因此选 doctor。
questions.supplement:
A(relative)：语境句：He invited all his close relatives to the wedding. 固定搭配：close relative, relative to
B(nurse)：语境句：The nurse took my blood pressure and temperature. 固定搭配：head nurse, registered nurse
C(patient)：语境句：The doctor advised the patient to rest for a few days. 固定搭配：treat a patient, be patient with
D(doctor)：语境句：You should see a doctor if the pain persists. 固定搭配：see a doctor, consult a doctor

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。朋友坚持要严肃对待作者的胃痛，所以作者立刻被“紧急送往(rushed)”医院。rush sb to somewhere 意为“赶紧把某人送到某地”，强调情况紧急。
questions.supplement:
A(called)：语境句：The witness called the police immediately after the accident. 固定搭配：call for, call off
B(rushed)：语境句：The injured passengers were rushed to the nearest hospital. 固定搭配：rush to do sth, in a rush
C(pushed)：语境句：She pushed the door open and walked into the room. 固定搭配：push forward, push for
D(moved)：语境句：His speech moved the audience to tears. 固定搭配：move to, move around

questions.explanation: 考查副词辨析。朋友在急诊室陪伴作者，说了恰当的话让作者“高效地(efficiently)”完成了整个就诊流程。其他选项不符合急诊室快速处理病情的逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(efficiently)：语境句：The new system allows us to process orders more efficiently. 固定搭配：work efficiently, operate efficiently
B(suddenly)：语境句：The weather suddenly changed and it started to rain. 固定搭配：stop suddenly, appear suddenly
C(officially)：语境句：The Olympic Games will be officially opened tomorrow. 固定搭配：officially announce, officially open
D(deliberately)：语境句：I believe he broke the glass deliberately. 固定搭配：do sth deliberately, deliberately ignore

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。医生朋友一直陪着作者，直到半夜作者的女儿们赶来，作者才让他“离开(leave)”。
questions.supplement:
A(send)：语境句：Please send me an email with the attached document. 固定搭配：send for, send out
B(greet)：语境句：The host came out to greet the guests at the door. 固定搭配：greet sb with a smile, warmly greet
C(admire)：语境句：I really admire your courage to speak the truth. 固定搭配：admire sb for sth, deeply admire
D(leave)：语境句：It's getting late, and I really must leave now. 固定搭配：leave for, leave behind

questions.explanation: 考查形容词辨析。医生朋友在劳累一天后仍来看望、护送并陪伴作者直到半夜，作者对此充满感激，表示永远“感激/欠情(indebted)”。
questions.supplement:
A(satisfied)：语境句：The teacher was completely satisfied with my performance. 固定搭配：be satisfied with, feel satisfied
B(devoted)：语境句：She is a devoted mother who gives everything to her children. 固定搭配：be devoted to, a devoted friend
C(indebted)：语境句：I am deeply indebted to my parents for their constant support. 固定搭配：be indebted to sb for sth, forever indebted
D(amused)：语境句：The children were highly amused by the clown's performance. 固定搭配：be amused by/at, keep sb amused

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。在急诊室处理两小时后，作者被告知需要“住院(be admitted)”。be admitted to the hospital 是医疗语境下的固定搭配，意为“被收治入院”。
questions.supplement:
A(compared)：语境句：The original painting was compared with the fake one. 固定搭配：compare A with/to B, compared to/with
B(admitted)：语境句：He was severely injured and admitted to the hospital immediately. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, be admitted to (school/hospital)
C(deserted)：语境句：The streets were completely deserted after the heavy snow. 固定搭配：desert one's post, a deserted island
D(cheated)：语境句：He was caught cheating in the final examination. 固定搭配：cheat on, cheat sb out of sth

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。下文提到亲戚朋友来探望、医护人员非常细心照料，这些都属于他人对作者的“关注/照顾(attention)”。unaccustomed 表示作者平时很少受到这样集中的照顾。
questions.supplement:
A(conclusion)：语境句：In conclusion, reading is highly beneficial to our mental growth. 固定搭配：draw a conclusion, come to a conclusion
B(attention)：语境句：The boy tried making noise to catch his mother's attention. 固定搭配：pay attention to, draw one's attention
C(excitement)：语境句：The fans shouted in excitement when their team scored. 固定搭配：in excitement, cause excitement
D(silence)：语境句：They listened to the headmaster's speech in complete silence. 固定搭配：in silence, break the silence

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。医护人员非常细心，尽管作者做梦也没想过要“麻烦/打扰(bothering)”别人。体现了作者既感激又有些过意不去的心情。
questions.supplement:
A(understanding)：语境句：Understanding different cultures is crucial for international business. 固定搭配：show understanding, mutual understanding
B(ordering)：语境句：The officer was ordering his men to retreat. 固定搭配：order sb to do sth, place an order
C(bothering)：语境句：I'm sorry for bothering you with such a trivial matter. 固定搭配：bother to do sth, bother about
D(cheering)：语境句：The crowd was cheering for the marathon runners. 固定搭配：cheer up, cheer for

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。在治疗的间隙，作者和其他病人“社交/交谈(socialized)”，还接受了实习护士的采访。socialize 符合与其他病人互动的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(socialized)：语境句：At the party, people socialized with colleagues from different departments. 固定搭配：socialize with, well-socialized
B(agreed)：语境句：We finally agreed on the date for the next meeting. 固定搭配：agree with, agree to do sth
C(competed)：语境句：Athletes from all over the world competed for the gold medals. 固定搭配：compete against/with, compete for
D(reasoned)：语境句：He reasoned that if they left early, they could avoid the traffic. 固定搭配：reason with sb, reason out

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。上文提到一位可爱的实习护士正在做一篇论文(doing a paper)，所以作者的故事会被收录在她的“研究/学业作业(studies)”中。
questions.supplement:
A(acts)：语境句：His heroic acts won him a medal of honor. 固定搭配：an act of kindness, catch sb in the act
B(duties)：语境句：It is our duty to protect the environment for future generations. 固定搭配：do one's duty, on duty
C(studies)：语境句：She plans to further her studies abroad next year. 固定搭配：further one's studies, academic studies
D(tricks)：语境句：The magician performed amazing tricks that surprised the audience. 固定搭配：play a trick on, learn the tricks of the trade

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。通过这次住院经历，朋友探望、家人陪伴、手机里充满关心的信息，让作者意识到有多少人在“关心(cared)”她。
questions.supplement:
A(cared)：语境句：She cared deeply about the welfare of abandoned animals. 固定搭配：care about, care for
B(suffered)：语境句：The country suffered heavily from the devastating earthquake. 固定搭配：suffer from, suffer a loss
C(aged)：语境句：The wine is aged in oak barrels for several years. 固定搭配：middle-aged, gracefully aged
D(matured)：语境句：He has matured a lot since he started working. 固定搭配：mature into, fully matured

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。这次经历起到了“提醒(reminder)”的作用，让作者意识到生命中有这么多美好的人。serve as a reminder 是固定表达。
questions.supplement:
A(task)：语境句：Completing this project on time is a challenging task. 固定搭配：take sb to task, perform a task
B(message)：语境句：Please leave a message after the beep. 固定搭配：leave a message, send a message
C(routine)：语境句：Exercising has become a part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
D(reminder)：语境句：The alarm clock serves as a reminder to wake me up early. 固定搭配：serve as a reminder, a constant reminder

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。这些美好的人的爱给予了作者“力量(strength)”，并且让她的生活充满欢乐。love gives me strength 符合逻辑和常见搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(wealth)：语境句：Health is generally considered more important than material wealth. 固定搭配：a wealth of, accumulate wealth
B(value)：语境句：This ancient coin is of great historical value. 固定搭配：of great value, value for money
C(strength)：语境句：He didn't have the strength to lift the heavy box. 固定搭配：give sb strength, build up one's strength
D(respect)：语境句：We should show respect for the elderly. 固定搭配：show respect to/for, out of respect

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。文章开头作者因为没看医生就吃止痛药而导致病情延误被急救，所以在结尾提出忠告：请保重身体，千万不要“忽视(ignore)”持续的胃痛！
questions.supplement:
A(notice)：语境句：Did you notice anything unusual about his behavior? 固定搭配：take notice of, without notice
B(overcome)：语境句：She managed to overcome her fear of public speaking. 固定搭配：overcome difficulties, overcome obstacles
C(reserve)：语境句：I would like to reserve a table for two for tonight. 固定搭配：reserve the right, in reserve
D(ignore)：语境句：You cannot ignore the fact that the climate is changing. 固定搭配：ignore advice, completely ignore

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give information to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去分词，用于when引导的省略结构，相当于when I was informed，表示时间状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: When informed of the decision, she felt relieved.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当被告知这个决定时，她感到宽慰。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When informed that I was to stay

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to talk about plans or arrangements
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 表示按计划或安排将要发生
vocab_pack.grammar_note: be to结构，was为过去时，表示当时计划即将住院。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is to leave for Paris tomorrow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他明天将动身去巴黎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was to stay in the hospital

vocab_pack.definition_en: to visit or contact someone to see if they are okay
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，checked为过去式；up on为固定搭配，后接宾语me。
vocab_pack.example_en: My mother calls every day to check up on me.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我妈妈每天打电话来关心我。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A young doctor friend checked up on me

vocab_pack.definition_en: persistent pain in the stomach
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，pains为复数形式，consistent为形容词修饰；句中作had的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She suffered from consistent stomach pain for weeks.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她连续几周遭受持续的胃痛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had mentioned consistent stomach pains

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consume medication for pain relief
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词taken用于过去完成时had taken，表示在之前的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: He takes painkillers when his headache becomes severe.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他头痛厉害时会服用止痛药。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I had taken painkillers without being to a doctor

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: insisted that my stomach pains be taken seriously
vocab_pack.definition_en: to demand forcefully that something happen (using subjunctive mood)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 坚持要求某事被做（虚拟语气）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: insist后接that从句，谓语用虚拟语气（省略should，直接用动词原形），此处be taken为被动虚拟原形；insisted为过去时。
vocab_pack.example_en: The doctor insisted that the patient be hospitalized immediately.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生坚持要求病人立即住院。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he insisted that my stomach pains be taken seriously

vocab_pack.definition_en: to treat something as important and worthy of attention
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构be taken seriously，taken为过去分词，be为原形（虚拟语气中）。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should take your health seriously.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该认真对待你的健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: my stomach pains be taken seriously

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be taken quickly to a hospital for urgent care
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构，rushed为过去分词，表示被紧急送到医院；by him为施动者。
vocab_pack.example_en: The injured man was rushed to hospital after the accident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 事故后伤者被紧急送往医院。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was rushed to the hospital by him

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go with someone as a companion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，accompanied为过去式，后接宾语me。
vocab_pack.example_en: She accompanied her friend to the airport.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她陪朋友去了机场。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He accompanied me in the emergency room

vocab_pack.definition_en: the part of a hospital that provides immediate medical treatment for urgent cases
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，句中作介词in的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was taken to the emergency room with a heart attack.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他因心脏病发作被送进急诊室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in the emergency room

vocab_pack.definition_en: to speak in an appropriate and helpful way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，said为过去式；all the right things为宾语，强调所说的话恰到好处。
vocab_pack.example_en: In a crisis, it's important to say the right thing to comfort others.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在危机中，说恰当的话来安慰他人很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: said all the right things to get me through

vocab_pack.definition_en: to help someone survive or complete something difficult
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，get为原形，me为间接宾语，through the process为介词短语表示过程。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her support helped me get through the tough times.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的支持帮助我度过了艰难时期。
vocab_pack.from_passage: get me through the process efficiently

vocab_pack.definition_en: to persuade or cause someone to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，got为过去式，后接him（宾格）和to leave不定式，表示让/说服他离开。
vocab_pack.example_en: I got my brother to help me with the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我让我哥哥帮我做这个项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I only got him to leave me until midnight

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely grateful, as if owing a debt of gratitude
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系表结构，indebted为形容词，forever副词修饰；am为系动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am forever indebted to my teachers for their patience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我永远感激老师们的耐心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I am forever indebted.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to allow someone to enter a hospital as a patient
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动不定式，be admitted表示将被接收住院；was to be admitted为过去将来被动。
vocab_pack.example_en: The patient was admitted to the hospital with severe pain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该病人因剧痛被收治入院。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was to be admitted.

vocab_pack.definition_en: attention that is not usual or familiar
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，unaccustomed为形容词修饰attention；作enjoyed的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The celebrity enjoyed the unaccustomed attention from fans.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位名人享受着粉丝们不寻常的关注。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I enjoyed all the unaccustomed attention.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that you would never consider doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: would表示意愿或过去常常，never dream of后接动名词bothering；I would never dream of...是一种强烈否定。
vocab_pack.example_en: I would never dream of lying to my parents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我做梦都不会对父母撒谎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: though I would never dream of bothering others

vocab_pack.definition_en: texts or notes expressing affection and worry
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作主语，filled为谓语动词；Messages首字母大写因在句首。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the earthquake, survivors received messages of love and concern from around the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 地震后，幸存者收到了来自世界各地的关爱和担忧的消息。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Messages of love and concern filled my phone.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to mix and interact with other people in a friendly way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，socialized为过去式，with为介词，后接other patients。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's important to socialize with colleagues at work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在工作中与同事社交很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I socialized with other patients

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be asked questions in an interview (often passive with 'get')
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动结构，get + 过去分词，got为过去式，表示经历了一次采访。
vocab_pack.example_en: She got interviewed for a job at the company.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她参加了那家公司的求职面试。
vocab_pack.from_passage: got interviewed by a delightful student nurse

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be made part of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动不定式，be included in中in为介词；would be included为过去将来被动。
vocab_pack.example_en: Your name will be included in the guest list.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你的名字将被列入宾客名单。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My story would be included in her studies!

vocab_pack.definition_en: to feel a very strong emotion, especially gratitude or joy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，am为第一人称单数现在时，overwhelmed为过去分词，with引出情感来源。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was overwhelmed with gratitude for the help she received.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她对得到的帮助感激不已。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I am overwhelmed with gratitude

vocab_pack.definition_en: a strong and sudden expression of love
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，outpouring为名词，后接of love；the为定冠词，句中作for的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: There was an outpouring of love for the victims of the disaster.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 人们向灾难受害者表达了大量关爱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: for the outpouring of love

vocab_pack.definition_en: ongoing help and encouragement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，continued为形容词修饰support；与messages and visits并列作for的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We thank you for your continued support over the years.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们感谢你们多年来的持续支持。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the messages and visits and continued support

vocab_pack.definition_en: to act as something that helps you remember
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 作为提醒，起到警示作用
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，serves为第三人称单数；as a reminder为介词短语作主语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This accident serves as a reminder to always wear a seatbelt.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次事故提醒人们始终系好安全带。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This experience serves as a reminder

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to know or realize something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作结果状语，make的现在分词making，后接宾语me和形容词短语aware of。
vocab_pack.example_en: The documentary made me aware of the importance of recycling.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部纪录片让我意识到回收利用的重要性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: making me aware of the wonderful people

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide emotional or physical power
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，gives为第三人称单数（主语whose love），me为间接宾语，strength为直接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her words of encouragement gave me strength to continue.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她鼓励的话语给了我继续的力量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: whose love gives me strength

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something full of happiness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，fill为原形（主语who指代people，复数），fill my life with joy为谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children's laughter fills the house with joy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们的笑声使屋子里充满欢乐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: who fill my life with joy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remain in good health
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 祈使句，stay为动词原形，well为副词，用于结尾祝愿。
vocab_pack.example_en: Stay well and take care of yourself.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 保持健康，照顾好自己。
vocab_pack.from_passage: stay well and please, do not ignore

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pay no attention to; to disregard
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 祈使句否定形式，do not ignore，ignore为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Do not ignore the warning signs of illness.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要忽视疾病的警示信号。
vocab_pack.from_passage: do not ignore a consistent stomachache

section_2_word_form.passage:
Beijing Central Axis was inscribed(写上) on the UNESCO World Heritage List on July 27, [56] marks China's 59th World Heritage Site. Initially constructed in the 13th century and shaped in the 16th century, it is an [57] (influence) masterpiece running north-south through the heart of the old city of Beijing, totaling 7.8 kilometers in [58] (long).

The newly inscribed World Heritage Site, consisting of 15 components, with the Bell and Drum Towers at its northern end and the Yongdingmen Gate at the southern end, [59] (present) a collection of building complexes and archaeological sites that governs the overall layout of Beijing's old city. World-famous [60] (landmark) like the Forbidden City and the Tian'anmen Square Complex, are along the Axis, and the Temple of Heaven and the Altar of the God of Agriculture [61] (locate) on the east and west sides of the Axis.

Beijing Central Axis is [62] (true) a remarkable sight showcasing the wisdom and creativity of ancient Chinese urban planners. Years of efforts in preservation and restoration have resulted [63] the successful inscription of Beijing Central Axis, which is [64] unique blend of history, culture and architecture. It has formed a magnificent urban architectural complex, [65] (witness) the ideal order of capital cities that has influenced the buildings of traditional Chinese cities for more than two thousands years.

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。逗号后引导非限制性定语从句，先行词是前面“北京中轴线被列入名录”这整个事件，在从句中作主语，故用 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He passed the exam, which made his parents very happy. 固定搭配：in which, by which。原词其它变形：无。

questions.explanation: 考查形容词。修饰后面的名词 masterpiece，需将名词 influence 变为形容词 influential，意为“有影响力的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(influential)：语境句：He is one of the most influential figures in modern science. 固定搭配：highly influential, an influential role。原词influence其它变形：influence(v./n.), uninfluenced(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查名词。介词 in 后需接名词，in length 为固定搭配，意为“在长度上”，故填 long 的名词形式 length。
questions.supplement: 正确形(length)：语境句：The river is over 300 kilometers in length. 固定搭配：in length, at length。原词long其它变形：long(adj./adv./v.), lengthen(v.)。

questions.explanation: 考查主谓一致和时态。该句主语是 The newly inscribed World Heritage Site (单数)，叙述客观事实用一般现在时，故填 presents。
questions.supplement: 正确形(presents)：语境句：The data presents a clear picture of the current economic situation. 固定搭配：present sth to sb, present a challenge。原词present其它变形：presentation(n.), presently(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。根据后面的举例 like the Forbidden City and the Tian'anmen Square Complex 可知，此处指多个地标建筑，故填复数 landmarks。
questions.supplement: 正确形(landmarks)：语境句：The Eiffel Tower is one of the most famous landmarks in Paris. 固定搭配：historical landmarks, cultural landmarks。原词landmark其它变形：无。

questions.explanation: 考查被动语态和主谓一致。主语是 the Temple of Heaven and the Altar of the God of Agriculture (复数)，表示“位于/坐落于”用 be located，陈述客观事实用一般现在时，故填 are located。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are located)：语境句：Many advanced technology companies are located in this area. 固定搭配：be located in/on/at。原词locate其它变形：location(n.), relocating(v.)。

questions.explanation: 考查副词。修饰整个句子或系动词后的表语部分，需用形容词 true 的副词形式 truly，意为“真正地，确实”。注意拼写去 e 加 ly。
questions.supplement: 正确形(truly)：语境句：It is truly an honor to be invited to this important conference. 固定搭配：yours truly, truly understand。原词true其它变形：truth(n.), truthful(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。result in 是固定搭配，意为“导致，结果是……”，句意为多年努力促成了中轴线申遗成功。
questions.supplement: 正确形(in)：语境句：The heavy rain resulted in a terrible traffic jam. 固定搭配：result in, result from。无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。blend 为单数可数名词，此处泛指“一种独特的融合”，且 unique 的首音素为辅音 /j/，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：The design is a unique blend of traditional and modern elements. 固定搭配：a blend of, a unique opportunity。无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。逻辑主语是前面的 a magnificent urban architectural complex，与 witness 之间是主动关系，作伴随状语或结果状语，故填现在分词 witnessing。
questions.supplement: 正确形(witnessing)：语境句：We are witnessing a period of rapid technological development. 固定搭配：bear witness to, an eyewitness。原词witness其它变形：witnessed(v-ed), witnesses(n./v.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to write or carve words, symbols, etc. on a surface; to officially record something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为被动语态一般过去时（was inscribed），表示“被列入”，主语Beijing Central Axis为动作承受者。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient temple was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage site last year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古庙去年被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List

vocab_pack.definition_en: having great influence or importance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作定语修饰masterpiece，形容词原形直接使用。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is one of the most influential figures in modern architecture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是现代建筑中最有影响力的人物之一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: an influential masterpiece

vocab_pack.definition_en: a work of outstanding artistry, skill, or workmanship
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为可数名词单数，与不定冠词an搭配，作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This painting is considered a masterpiece of Renaissance art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这幅画被认为是文艺复兴艺术的杰作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it is an influential masterpiece

vocab_pack.definition_en: to extend in a specified direction; to be situated or arranged
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 延伸；走向（指路线、道路等）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在分词形式（running），作伴随状语，表示主动且与主语it构成逻辑主谓关系，描述轴线南北走向。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Great Wall runs across northern China for thousands of kilometers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 长城横跨中国北部，绵延数千公里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: running north-south through the heart of the old city of Beijing

vocab_pack.definition_en: to amount to a particular number; to add up to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在分词形式（totaling），作伴随状语，表示主动，补充说明主轴总长度。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project costs total over ten million dollars.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目成本总计超过一千万美元。
vocab_pack.from_passage: totaling 7.8 kilometers in length

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to specify the measurement of something from end to end
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：固定短语，与数字和单位连用，说明物体的长度，在句中作状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bridge is 200 meters in length.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座桥长200米。
vocab_pack.from_passage: totaling 7.8 kilometers in length

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be made up or composed of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在分词短语（consisting of），作定语修饰site，表示主动，说明新列入遗产地的构成部分。
vocab_pack.example_en: The committee consists of twelve members from different countries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该委员会由来自不同国家的十二名成员组成。
vocab_pack.from_passage: consisting of 15 components

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or offer something for others to see or consider
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般现在时第三人称单数（presents），主语The newly inscribed World Heritage Site为单数，表示客观事实。
vocab_pack.example_en: The exhibition presents a wide range of modern art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 展览呈现了多种现代艺术作品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presents a collection of building complexes

vocab_pack.definition_en: a group of buildings that are designed together as a single unit
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为复数形式（building complexes），作介词of的宾语，泛指多个建筑群。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new building complex includes a shopping mall and two office towers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新建的建筑群包括一个购物中心和两座办公塔楼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a collection of building complexes and archaeological sites

vocab_pack.definition_en: to control, influence, or rule over something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为一般现在时第三人称单数（governs），关系代词that指代a collection...，作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The rules govern the use of public spaces in the city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些规则支配着城市公共空间的使用。
vocab_pack.from_passage: that governs the overall layout of Beijing's old city

vocab_pack.definition_en: known to people all over the world
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为复合形容词作定语，修饰landmarks，相当于一个整体形容词，无变形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The world-famous opera singer will perform here tonight.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位世界著名的歌剧演唱家今晚将在此演出。
vocab_pack.from_passage: World-famous landmarks like the Forbidden City

vocab_pack.definition_en: a prominent or well-known object or feature that is easily recognized
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为名词复数形式（landmarks），作主语，此处指多个著名地标。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Eiffel Tower is one of the most famous landmarks in the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是世界上最著名的地标之一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: World-famous landmarks like the Forbidden City

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be situated in a particular place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为过去分词（located），与are构成被动语态，表示“被位于”，说明天坛和先农坛的位置。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new library is located in the center of the campus.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新图书馆位于校园中心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: are located on the east and west sides of the Axis

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a truthful or genuine way; really
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为副词，修饰系动词is，加强语气，表示“确实是”。
vocab_pack.example_en: This is truly a remarkable achievement for the team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这对团队来说确实是一个了不起的成就。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Beijing Central Axis is truly a remarkable sight

vocab_pack.definition_en: to display or exhibit something in an attractive way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在分词（showcasing），作伴随状语，修饰sight，表示主动，说明该景观展现了智慧与创造力。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum showcases the history of the ancient city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该博物馆展示了这座古城的历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a remarkable sight showcasing the wisdom and creativity

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who designs and organizes the development of towns and cities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为名词复数（urban planners），作介词of的宾语，泛指所有古代中国城市规划者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Urban planners must balance economic growth with environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 城市规划师必须平衡经济增长与环境保护。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the wisdom and creativity of ancient Chinese urban planners

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of keeping something in its original state or good condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为不可数名词，与restoration并列，作介词in的宾语，表示“在保护和修复方面的努力”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The preservation of historical buildings is a priority for the city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 历史建筑的保护是该城市的优先事项。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Years of efforts in preservation and restoration

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of returning something to its original condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为不可数名词，与preservation并列，作介词in的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The restoration of the ancient temple took over a decade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古庙的修复耗时十多年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Years of efforts in preservation and restoration

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause a particular situation or outcome
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在完成时（have resulted in），主语efforts为复数，表示过去持续到现在的努力产生的结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: Careful planning resulted in a successful event.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 周密的计划带来了成功的活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have resulted in the successful inscription of Beijing Central Axis

vocab_pack.definition_en: achieving the desired outcome or result
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作定语，修饰inscription，表示“成功的列入”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her successful application earned her a scholarship.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她成功的申请为她赢得了奖学金。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the successful inscription of Beijing Central Axis

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of officially adding something to a list; something that is inscribed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为可数名词单数，指“列入（世界遗产名录）”这一事件。
vocab_pack.example_en: The inscription of the site on the World Heritage List was widely celebrated.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该遗址列入世界遗产名录受到了广泛庆祝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the successful inscription of Beijing Central Axis

vocab_pack.definition_en: being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作定语，修饰blend，表示“独特的融合”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city has a unique charm that attracts tourists from all over.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市有一种独特的魅力，吸引了来自世界各地的游客。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a unique blend of history, culture and architecture

vocab_pack.definition_en: a mixture of different things or qualities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为可数名词单数，与不定冠词a搭配，作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This musical style is a blend of jazz and rock.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种音乐风格是爵士乐和摇滚乐的融合。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a unique blend of history, culture and architecture

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely beautiful, impressive, or grand
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作定语，修饰urban architectural complex，表示“宏伟的城市建筑群”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The palace is a magnificent structure with hundreds of rooms.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座宫殿是一座拥有数百个房间的宏伟建筑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a magnificent urban architectural complex

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large group of buildings and structures that form a coherent urban design
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 城市建筑群；城市建筑综合体
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为名词短语，作动词has formed的宾语，单数形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The modern urban architectural complex includes residential towers and a park.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座现代城市建筑群包括住宅塔楼和一个公园。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a magnificent urban architectural complex

vocab_pack.definition_en: to see, hear, or experience something happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在分词（witnessing），作伴随状语，表示主语It（北京中轴线）主动见证，描述其作为首都理想秩序的见证者。
vocab_pack.example_en: The old town has witnessed many historical changes over the centuries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座古镇几个世纪以来见证了许多历史变迁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: witnessing the ideal order of capital cities

vocab_pack.definition_en: perfect or most suitable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作定语，修饰order，表示“理想的秩序”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The location is ideal for a new school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个位置非常适合建一所新学校。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the ideal order of capital cities

vocab_pack.definition_en: the city that is the official seat of government for a country or region
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为复数形式（capital cities），作介词of的宾语，泛指历史上的多个都城。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many capital cities have a central axis that reflects their planning philosophy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多首都城市都有一条反映其规划哲学的中轴线。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the ideal order of capital cities

vocab_pack.definition_en: to affect or change the way someone or something develops
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中为现在完成时第三人称单数（has influenced），关系代词that指代ideal order，表示从过去持续到现在的影响。
vocab_pack.example_en: The political system has greatly influenced the country's culture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政治制度极大地影响了该国的文化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: that has influenced the buildings of traditional Chinese cities

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to the study of ancient cultures through their material remains
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：句中作定语，修饰sites，与building complexes并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The archaeological site contains ruins of an ancient city.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个考古遗址包含一座古城的废墟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: building complexes and archaeological sites
